testCase:
D-07: Month and year dropdowns for a birth date
Goal: Save 23 July 1988 as the date of birth.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-07/
STEP 2: Click "Date of birth"
STEP 3: Select "July" in "Month" and "1988" in "Year"
STEP 4: Click "23 July 1988"
STEP 5: Click "Save"
STEP 6: Verify "Saved date of birth: 23 July 1988" is visible

plan.title: D-07: Save birth date using month and year dropdowns

steps.note: Verify the exact saved-date confirmation is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that 23 July 1988 can be selected and saved as the date of birth. The plan selects the month and year before the day, then verifies the saved-date confirmation.
